title: Privacy Policy
html:
Privacy Policy

Advantage Data Vision respects the privacy of clinicians, researchers, healthcare institutions, partners, and website visitors. This draft policy explains how we may collect, use, store, and protect information when you visit our website, contact our team, or evaluate our medical technology products.

Information We Collect

We may collect contact details, organization information, enquiry content, technical logs, browser information, and product evaluation information provided directly by users. Where clinical or research data is involved, ADV expects such data to be handled under a separate written agreement with the relevant healthcare institution, research sponsor, or authorized partner.

Use of Information

Information may be used to respond to enquiries, provide product demonstrations, improve website performance, support partnership discussions, maintain security, and communicate updates about our virtual patient simulation, personalized deep feature, and real-world data search solutions.

Medical and Research Data

ADV does not intend this public website to receive identifiable patient records, diagnostic images, genomic files, pathology records, or other regulated health information. Any processing of healthcare, clinical, or research data should be governed by a project-specific agreement, applicable ethics approval, institutional policy, and relevant privacy law.

Security

We use reasonable technical and organizational safeguards to protect information from unauthorized access, misuse, alteration, or loss. No website or network transmission can be guaranteed to be fully secure.

Contact

For privacy-related enquiries, please contact yunfanxiang@adv-medical.com.hk.
